São sempre mais da mesma coisa. Este filme não é, propriamente, uma excepção...

I'm a fan of Wan, and while I must say I believe that The Conjuring is pretty severely overrated, it's also one of the best horror films to have hit the mainstream in the past few years. Final rating:★★½ - Had a lot that appealed to me, didn’t quite work as a whole.
